name: Items out
query:
SELECT
    sle.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:130",
    it.item_name AS "Item Name:Data:200",

    SUM(CASE WHEN sle.actual_qty > 0 THEN sle.actual_qty ELSE 0 END) AS "In Qty:Float:90",
    SUM(CASE WHEN sle.actual_qty > 0 THEN sle.stock_value_difference ELSE 0 END) AS "In Value:Currency:120",

    SUM(CASE WHEN sle.actual_qty < 0 THEN -sle.actual_qty ELSE 0 END) AS "Out Qty:Float:90",
    SUM(CASE WHEN sle.actual_qty < 0 THEN -sle.stock_value_difference ELSE 0 END) AS "Out Value:Currency:120",

    SUM(sle.actual_qty) AS "Balance Qty:Float:110",
    SUM(sle.stock_value_difference) AS "Balance Value:Currency:130"

FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
INNER JOIN `tabItem` it ON it.name = sle.item_code

WHERE
    sle.is_cancelled = 0
    AND sle.warehouse = 'Main Store - SH'

GROUP BY sle.item_code, it.item_name
ORDER BY it.item_name;
